worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.summary: Sends a hypnotic suggestion down a clear line into the target's mind and puts it to sleep at once. It works at range and instantly, but the outcome is a contest of will — if the user's Special Attack and level cannot overpower the target's Special Defence and level, the rings only scatter into a little drowsiness.
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.use.0: Drop a distant threat before the fight starts
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.use.1: Open a sleep window for an ally's Dream Eater or Nightmare
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.use.2: Force an opponent to break line of sight or back off
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.description.0: Gaze down an unobstructed line; the gaze reach is %1$s. Whether it takes hold is a contest of will, currently %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.description.1: The target sleeps for %1$s and cannot act until awakened by a hit.
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.focus.on: Steady gaze: success ×1.25 and sleep ×1.2, at the cost of reach ×0.85, +3 ticks wind-up and cooldown ×1.15.
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.focus.off: Loose gaze: reach ×1.2, quick wind-up and short cooldown, at the cost of success ×0.8 and sleep ×0.8.
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.growth.1: From level %1$s the sleep is %2$s and the success %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.preference.fo: On: success ×1.25 and sleep ×1.2, but reach ×0.85, +3 ticks wind-up and cooldown ×1.15 — for pinning one target down. Off (loose): reach ×1.2, quick wind-up and short cooldown, but success ×0.8 and sleep ×0.8 — for trying again and again at a fast pace.
worldcombat.skill.hypnosis.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the move's priority drops to 12 and the partner closes in before gazing (it still casts, it just will not gamble across the gap); smaller keeps it in close, larger lets it try from farther out.
Anytime: gaze at any threat. When bitten: gaze only right after the partner is hit.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to gaze.
